You will work closely with customers, consultants, sales teams, and technology partners to shape solution strategy, translate complex requirements into compelling architectures, and demonstrate the business and technical value of Schneider Electric’s portfolio. If you are passionate about digital transformation, energy management, automation, smart infrastructure, and turning complex customer challenges into winning solutions, this role offers the visibility, ownership, and impact to shape strategic opportunities and influence customer decisions. What will you do? Lead discovery workshops with customers, consultants, and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational challenges, technical requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and success criteria. Develop end-to-end solution architectures integrating Schneider Electric offers across power management, building management, automation, energy management, digital services, and third-party systems. Prepare solution concepts, architectures, presentations, and cost-effective solution options aligned with customer specifications. Partner with sales teams to position differentiated value, influence specifications, support customer demonstrations, and present solutions to technical and executive stakeholders. Coordinate with product specialists, application engineers, cybersecurity teams, partners, and contractors to validate feasibility, interoperability, performance, and lifecycle support. Ensure proposed architectures follow applicable standards, cybersecurity-by-design principles, Schneider Electric guidelines, and customer sustainability objectives. Capture lessons learned, create reusable architectures and proposal assets, and contribute to continuous improvement of the solution-creation process. What are the key skills we are looking for? Solution Architecture - advanced level; converting complex requirements into scalable, resilient, and maintainable end-to-end architectures. Electrical and Digital Energy Systems - understanding power distribution, power monitoring, energy management, automation, and connected digital platforms. Building and Systems Integration - integrating BMS, power, HVAC, lighting, metering, security, IT/OT, and third-party systems using open protocols and APIs. Consultative Selling and Value Engineering - linking technical design to customer outcomes, lifecycle value, sustainability, and commercial competitiveness. Stakeholder Communication - presenting clearly to customers, consultants, contractors, sales teams, and executive decision-makers. Collaboration and Ownership - leading multidisciplinary teams, managing ambiguity, prioritizing actions, and taking accountability for solution quality. What qualifications will make you successful? Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Typically 5-8 years of experience in solution architecture, presales engineering, systems integration, electrical distribution, building automation, industrial automation, energy management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience designing multidisciplinary solutions and integrating hardware, software, networks, and third-party systems. Experience with Schneider Electric platforms such as EcoStruxure Building Operation, EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert, AVEVA solutions, or comparable market platforms is an advantage. Ability to interpret specifications, single-line diagrams, control schematics, network architectures, sequences of operation, and tender documents. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; French is an advantage. Professional certifications in solution architecture, project management, energy management, sustainability, networking, or cybersecurity are an advantage. What's in it for me? Impactful work where your technical solutions directly drive customer success and business growth Exposure to innovative projects in sustainability, energy management, and digital transformation Supportive team culture with robust learning opportunities, certifications, and career advancement paths Flexible work arrangements that respect your work-life balance Bring your technical passion to a role where it truly matters — apply today! At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page. Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available. Looking to make an IMPACT with your career? When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us. IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play.
